mapper.sql: p.id, p.doc_no, p.name, p.category, p.brand, p.source, p.platform, p.marketplace, p.currency, p.competitor_url, p.competitor_price, p.competitor_reviews, p.competitor_rating, p.est_monthly_sales, p.target_price, p.est_purchase_price, p.weight_kg, p.length_cm, p.width_cm, p.height_cm, p.est_profit, p.est_margin, p.owner_id, p.images, p.status, p.prev_status, p.flow_instance_id, p.material_id, p.approve_by, p.approve_time, p.reject_reason, p.remark, p.dept_id, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_time, c.name AS category_name, ou.nickname AS owner_name, cu.nickname AS create_by_name, au.nickname AS approve_by_name, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS sample_count, COALESCE(s.passed_count, 0) AS passed_sample_count, COALESCE(s.sample_fee, 0) AS sample_fee

FROM ecom_dev_project p LEFT JOIN wms_material_category c ON c.code = p.category LEFT JOIN sys_user ou ON ou.id = p.owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = p.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = p.approve_by LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS sample_count, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_count, SUM(COALESCE(sample_fee, 0)) AS sample_fee FROM ecom_dev_sample GROUP BY project_id) s ON s.project_id = p.id

where.if: AND (p.doc_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.selling_points LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
